visual_goal: Show brand journey teams consuming connectivity, complicated subsystems and group platforms, with contract stewards supplying schemas to the platforms.
prompt: A simple organization map of five rounded boxes. Top center: one wide blue box labeled 'Brand journey teams', showing two small clusters of three generic people side by side. Bottom row, evenly spaced under it: a teal box labeled 'Connectivity' with a plug icon on the left, a purple box labeled 'Subsystems' with a gear icon in the middle, and a green box labeled 'Group platforms' with a stacked-layers icon on the right. Three straight arrows go down from the blue box, one into each bottom box; only the arrow into 'Group platforms' carries the label 'as a service'. At the far right, a small gray box labeled 'Contract stewards' with a scroll icon, with one arrow pointing left into 'Group platforms' labeled 'schemas'. Exactly four arrows.
alt: Brand journey teams use connectivity, subsystems and group platforms as a service; contract stewards supply schemas to the group platforms.

visual_goal: Show a proposal routed by blast radius to the team, the forum or the board, with all three writing to one decision log that feeds governance measures.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. At the far left a document with a pencil labeled 'Proposal'. One arrow to an orange diamond labeled 'Shared contract?'. From it an arrow labeled 'no' to a blue rounded box labeled 'Team', and an arrow labeled 'yes' to a second orange diamond labeled 'Funding or dispute?'. From the second diamond an arrow labeled 'no' to a teal rounded box labeled 'Forum', and an arrow labeled 'yes' to a green rounded box labeled 'Board'. The three boxes 'Team', 'Forum' and 'Board' sit stacked in one column; one arrow from each goes right into a single open book labeled 'Decision log'. One arrow from the book to a small gauge dial labeled 'Measures'. Exactly nine arrows.
alt: A proposal passes two questions and goes to the team, the forum or the board; all three write to one decision log, which feeds governance measures.

visual_goal: Show the supplier-integration on-call flow: a rejection reaches the delivery tracker, the connectivity on-call is paged, opens a partner incident and brings in customer service, and the corrected reservation is accepted.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with five vertical lanes, each headed by a simple icon and label: 'Channel manager' (generic server), 'Gateway' (gate icon), 'Tracker' (clipboard with check marks), 'On-call' (generic engineer with headset), 'Duty manager' (generic support agent). Horizontal arrows top to bottom in time order: a dashed arrow from 'Channel manager' to 'Gateway' labeled 'rejected'; from 'Gateway' to 'Tracker' labeled 'rejected'; from 'Tracker' to 'On-call' with a small bell icon labeled 'page'; from 'On-call' back to 'Channel manager' labeled 'partner incident'; from 'On-call' to 'Duty manager' labeled 'arrivals'; a dashed arrow from 'Channel manager' to 'Gateway' labeled 'fixed'; from 'Gateway' to 'Tracker' labeled 'accepted'. Seven arrows in total.
alt: Swimlanes for channel manager, gateway, tracker, on-call and duty manager: a rejection reaches the tracker, which pages on-call; on-call opens a partner incident and alerts the duty manager about arrivals; the fix is resent and accepted.
